title: Indeed Done
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：indeed　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 indeed 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Indeed, in 1953 the counsellor proved the letter at the bench, and everybody in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three evenings on, people still spoke of that morning: before the June rains the counsellor had ② indeed proved the letter, and nobody had asked a single question. The counsellor had come to the garden two evenings earlier, and spoke little of the garden he had left behind him.

The journal for June 1947 puts it plainer. The letter was ③ indeed rare, and the listener who kept it had ④ indeed told it twice before the winter came; nothing in the garden was ever done indeed in those days. The listener wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every evening thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant something else. He proved the letter ⑤ indeed in silence, and nobody in the garden doubted it; of all who proved it that evening, he proved it ⑥ indeed in public. He was not a man who explained himself, and the garden had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1960 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was that the letter be told ⑦ indeed every evening, and that whoever did it be ⑧ indeed careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done indeed.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1963 she proved the letter ⑨ indeed in public when nobody else would, and ⑩ Indeed, she said in 1965, that was the part the garden never forgot; the journal still speaks indeed of it. She kept the letter in the same bench for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the garden never forgot how indeed it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 确实（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had indeed proved …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 确实（修饰形容词：indeed rare）
C. adv. 真的（评注性状语，置于句首：Indeed, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 真的（修饰过去分词：had indeed told it）
E. adv. 确实（句末状语：… indeed in silence）
F. adv. 确实（句末状语：… indeed in public，第 6 处）
G. adv. 真的（被动结构中的中位状语：be told indeed）
H. adv. 真的（修饰形容词：be indeed careful about the whole business）

answers.why: indeed 意为“确实”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Indeed, in 1953 …。
indeed 意为“确实”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had indeed proved the letter。
indeed 意为“确实”，此处修饰形容词 rare（罕见）：was indeed rare。
indeed 意为“真的”，此处修饰过去分词 told：had indeed told it twice。
indeed 意为“确实”，此处置于句末修饰动词：proved the letter indeed in silence。
indeed 意为“确实”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 黄昏, he did it indeed in public。
indeed 意为“真的”，被动结构 be told indeed 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
indeed 意为“真的”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be indeed careful about the whole business。
indeed 意为“确实”，1963 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次证明那件薄薄的信，副词置于动词之后。
indeed 意为“真的”，母亲 1965 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Indeed, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1953 年，谈心人真的在长椅证明那件薄薄的信；小园里人人都说那是头一回。（Indeed, …）
雨季到来之前，谈心人已经确实证明那件薄薄的信。（had indeed proved …）
那件薄薄的信当时确实罕见。（indeed rare）
保管它的那位倾听者在入冬前已经真的把它说出过两回。（had indeed told it）
叔叔确实证明那件薄薄的信，小园里没有一个人怀疑。（… indeed …）
在那个黄昏里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最确实。（the most indeed of all of them）
answers: Indeed, in 1953 the counsellor proved the letter at the bench.
Before the June rains the counsellor had indeed proved the letter.
The listener who kept it had indeed told it twice before the winter came.
He proved the letter indeed in silence, and nobody in the garden doubted it.
Of all who did it that evening, he did it indeed in public.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 indeed 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Indeed, in 1953 the counsellor proved the letter, and nobody forgot it.
Before the June rains the counsellor had indeed proved the letter.
The letter was indeed rare, or so the journal says.
The listener had indeed told it twice before the winter came.
My mother proved the letter indeed in public when nobody else would.
Indeed, the garden never forgot that part of the story.
